verification: Prevent automatic legal-interpretation changes and preserve evaluation lineage

evidence.text: ai/workflows/outcome_feedback.py evaluate_feedback attributes TAX-069 reviewed final outcomes (upheld/partially_overturned/overturned) to the component versions that informed each decision (TAX-061 playbook/tool stamps, risk rule versions, TAX-052 authority versions). A component version with >=3 final outcomes and overturn share >=1/2 becomes a component_review_proposal (legal authorities: legal_review_referral) citing overturned cases with decision digests and challenge IDs plus upheld counter-evidence; withdrawn/unresolved challenges excluded with reasons. Proposals are status proposed, auto_apply false, approved_by null; requested action is supervisor review leading to a new reviewed version, never an in-place edit.

tests/ai/test_outcome_feedback.py (8 tests, real TAX-061 registry stamps when LangGraph is installed): related_party@1.0 proposal with 3/4 overturned and dec-003 upheld as counter-evidence; below-threshold components reported but not proposed; legal authority only referred with legal_interpretation_change null and automatic_change_permitted false; apply() refuses every proposal with automatic_change_not_permitted and applied_changes is empty; withdrawn/no-final-outcome excluded and a changed original decision (dec-008) reported as a lineage problem and not counted; lineage records content digest, registry version and (decision_id, decision_digest, challenge_id) with a reproducible lineage digest, identical under reordered/duplicate delivery (an ordering bug found by this test was fixed); versions tracked separately; no taxpayer identifiers in output; malformed/cross-tenant/conflicting-lineage input refused. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 277 passed; ruff/mypy pass; TAX-056 gate PASS.

Tests and evidence recorded on task/TAX-070 (criteria 1-2). Branch refreshed from main; conflicts with TAX-067 (#204) in ci.yml/dev.py/README resolved keeping both and all checks rerun (287 AI tests, gate PASS); pushed explicitly; human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/205 opened with the CI billing block documented. Agent will not merge.
